SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-07: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — ViewDefinition.select.repeat. Test these items: repeat 0..* FHIRPath expressions for recursive traversal, view runner recursively follows each path to any depth, multiple repeat paths are combined using union semantics, duplicates and ordering behavior for recursive results, cycle/depth guard behavior under malformed or cyclic structures, columns are evaluated against each repeated node context. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition.select.repeat is 0..* string and repeat recursively evaluates each FHIRPath path; FHIR JSON array properties should be omitted when empty unless explicitly allowed, so present repeat: [] is invalid input and must not behave like repeat absence.
issues.evidence: Fresh QA probe showed parse_view_definition({select:[{repeat: [], column:[...]}]}) accepted repeat=[]; SQLGenerator emitted SQL without fhirpath_repeat; direct ViewDefinition(... Select(repeat=[])).to_dict() emitted repeat: [] and generator also omitted repeat traversal. This converts invalid present-empty repeat into default $this/root column evaluation.
issues.root_cause: validate_repeat_paths() accepted an empty list, and downstream SQL generation used truthiness checks (`if select.repeat`) so present repeat: [] bypassed fhirpath_repeat and behaved like an absent repeat directive.
issues.resolution: Require present Select.repeat arrays to contain at least one non-empty string in the shared validate_repeat_paths() helper, covering parser, ViewDefinition.from_dict(), Select.to_dict(), and direct SQLGenerator preflight. Added parser, serializer, generator, and fresh native/fallback execution probe coverage.
